Java and DevOps; using Kubernetes, Terraform, and Spring

Hi, I’m Tony Waters — a Java Developer with a strong DevOps focus.

I specialise in Java, Spring, and clean design, backed by Sun Certified Java credentials and enterprise development certifications. On the DevOps side, I work with Kubernetes, Helm, and Terraform, primarily in AWS, with local setups using Docker and Minikube.

I’m comfortable across the stack — from backend systems and JPA/SQL to front-end (using JavaScript, HTML, CSS, AngularJS). I’ve worked with everything from Oracle to lightweight in-memory databases like H2.

Most of my time is spent in an IDE or terminal. My GitHub and Docker Hub reflect the standard of my work

You can Email me - tony - at bit1.uk
